banner.title: UI/UX preview — demo data only
banner.body: This is a development-only preview of the student dashboard. All students, classes, payments, and links shown here are fictional. No real accounts, payments, or Zoom sessions are involved.

welcome.subtitle: Here is what is happening with your learning today.

todaysClass.notJoinableNote: The join link opens 10 minutes before class starts.

none.title: No class scheduled today
none.body: Enjoy the break. Your next session details appear below.

filteredEmpty.title: No subjects match this filter
filteredEmpty.body: Try a different filter to see your other subjects.

empty.title: No subjects yet
empty.body: Browse the course catalogue to enrol in your first subject.

empty.title: Nothing scheduled
empty.body: Upcoming classes for your enrolled subjects will show here.

empty.title: No resources yet
empty.body: Lesson recordings and study materials appear here once your teacher adds them.

note.approved: Your payment is approved and course access is active.
note.pending: Your payment is submitted and awaiting verification by the finance team.
note.overdue: This payment is overdue and some content is locked. Upload your slip to restore access.

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.body: Your monthly invoices appear here once you enrol in a subject.

items.holidayTitle: Public holiday — no classes on 1 November
items.holidayBody: All live sessions on Friday 1 November are rescheduled. Recordings for missed lessons will be posted the same evening.
items.examBody: The Grade 9 term test begins on 18 November. Check the schedule page for your subject-wise sitting times.
items.resourceBody: Practice worksheets for quadratic equations are now available under your Mathematics resources.

empty.title: No announcements
empty.body: Institute notices and class updates will appear here.

errorState.title: Something went wrong
errorState.body: We could not load your dashboard. Check your connection and try again.

demoDialog.title: Join class (demo)
demoDialog.body: In the real dashboard this opens the live Zoom session for {{subject}}. This preview uses demo data, so no real classroom link is opened.
